plan.summary: Introduce a REVERSE movement order that moves a vehicle one grid cell opposite its current orientation without rotating it, while preserving board-boundary and simultaneous-collision rules.
steps: Add REVERSE to the MovementOrder enum.
Add position-domain behavior for moving one cell opposite a supplied orientation.

Handle REVERSE in MovementEngine.applyOrder, retaining the vehicle's orientation and allowing the existing intention and conflict-resolution phases to process reverse movement identically to forward movement.

Update the game rules to define reverse vectors, orientation behavior, boundary handling, and interaction with existing simultaneous collision rules, and remove reverse movement from the out-of-scope list.
tests: Verify REVERSE moves north-, east-, south-, and west-facing vehicles one cell in the opposite direction without changing orientation.
Verify reverse movement that would leave each board edge is blocked.
Verify reverse movement is blocked when its target is occupied by a stationary vehicle.
Verify reverse and forward movers targeting the same cell are both blocked.
Verify a position swap involving reverse movement is blocked.
Verify reverse movement can enter a cell successfully vacated during the same turn and participates correctly in propagated blocking chains.
Run the backend unit test suite with ./mvnw test.
